candidates.snippet: 1870: Birth of Vladimir Lenin - Born Vladimir Ilyich Ulyanov in Simbirsk, Russia. 1902: Publication of 'What is to be Done?' - Lenin published his influential pamphlet outlining his vision for the Bolshevik party. 1917: October Revolution - Lenin led the Bolsheviks in overthrowing the Provisional Government, seizing power in Russia. 1924: Death of Vladimir Lenin - Died in Gorki, Russia, following a series of strokes.
